leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a hash-based routing system that responds to URL fragment changes
Construct a history-based routing system using the browser's History API
Initialize and manage application state to track the current route
Bind event listeners to handle browser navigation events
Render different UI components based on the active route
Configure route mappings between URL patterns and corresponding views
Update the browser URL programmatically without page reloads
lessonTitle: Build mini router hash and history mode
